title: Spaghetti with Edamame, Grape Tomatoes, Broccoli & Basil Pesto

steps.text: Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until almost done, about 8 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and halve tomatoes lengthwise. Set aside.
When the pasta is almost done, add broccoli and edamame to the pot. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until pasta reaches desired firmness and veggies are tender, 2-3 minutes more.
When the pasta and veggies are done, drain in the colander and return to the pot. Add tomatoes and pesto, then toss to combine.
To serve, divide pasta between plates or bowls and top with Parmesan. Enjoy!
